name.zh: 野兽控制 Beta 开荒

summary.zh: 先拿致命守护触发 30% 远程攻速，再补移动速度，以及复活更快、跟得上你的宠物。
summary.en: Deadly Aspects for a 30% ranged attack speed proc, then movement speed and a pet that revives fast and keeps up with you.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，猎人最通用的起手方案
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, the strongest general-purpose Hunter opening

pros.zh: 致命守护让雄鹰守护生效时，自动射击有 10% 几率使远程攻击速度提高 30%，持续 12 秒，是这个等级猎人能拿到的最强天赋。
pros.en: Deadly Aspects gives Auto Shot a 10% chance to raise ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds while Aspect of the Hawk is active: the single best talent any Hunter can take at this level.

pros.zh: 寻路让猎豹守护与豹群守护的速度加成再提高 6%，在没有坐骑的阶段，每一次赶路都能感受到。
pros.en: Pathfinding adds 6% to Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack, which you feel on every trip between quests before mounts.

pros.zh: 强化复活宠物让复活宠物少用 6 秒施法时间和 40% 法力，野兽迅捷让宠物移动速度提高 30%，抢先咬住目标。
pros.en: Improved Revive Pet cuts 6 seconds and 40% of the Mana from Revive Pet, and Bestial Swiftness keeps the pet 30% faster so it reaches the target first.

pros.zh: 只追求地下城 AoE？射击方案会彻底放弃宠物，换取独来独往与更强的多重射击。
pros.en: Only chasing dungeon AoE? The Marksmanship build gives up the pet entirely for Lone Wolf and a much stronger Multi-Shot.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
